$comment: Safety allowance: a hypothetical scenario on the benchmarks page, never a measured score. A trial a provider safety stop or refusal ended (fetch_runs.py safety_cells: unrewarded AgentSafetyRefusalError / AgentSafetyStopError) counts as a pass when its task is easy for the run's reference model: the reference passed at least minPasses of its attempts. Each run uses the first reference listing its family, else the default. A reference is a site run (by id, passes after review) or an external per-task pass table with its source.
label: Safety allowance
rule: A task is easy when the reference model passed at least 4 of 5 attempts: Claude Haiku 5.5 (high) for Anthropic models, GPT-6 Luna (high) for every other model.

references.label: Claude Haiku 5.5 high
references.note: Reference for Anthropic models: our Claude Haiku 5.5 high run (GitHub Copilot), 5 attempts per task, passes after review.

references.label: GPT-6 Luna high
references.note: Reference for every other model: our GPT-6 Luna high run (API key, flex tier), 5 attempts per task, passes after review.
